relevance_note: Narrative review whose Table 1 lists 20 previously published LAD/LAD-1 patients with individual age, sex and lesions ('Cases of concomitant pyoderma gangrenosum and leukocyte adhesion deficiency'), and whose text describes 'a 20-year-old male' with a 'c.10+4A>G mutation' in ITGB2 [17].
method_note: A Python script transcribed Table 1 (20 data rows, no label column, so labels are 'Table 1 row k'); I checked its output against the table. The Author cell (e.g. 'Kerkhof, 1990') is copied to source_reference_in_review. The 'Patient Age, Sex' cell gives age (recorded as age at last evaluation/report; units not printed except '6 mo', years assumed for the ISO value) and sex. Immunodeficiency cell is the disease label. Treatment bullets are joined with '; '. Every Table 1 row is a case of PG with LAD per the table title, so 'PG Lesions' is observed with the location as detail; the text says 5 of the 20 had PG-like rather than classical PG but does not name them, so no distinction is made. Culture Result cells recorded as observed features ('Culture Result: ...'); 'Negative' recorded as 'positive culture' excluded (D-27). Organisms cultured from lesions (e.g. Candida, Aspergillus, Fusarium) were NOT taken as checklist 'fungal infections' or 'skin or soft tissue infections' because the paper does not call them infections of the person. Outcome cells: 'Sepsis due to perianal necrosis' (row 2) gives sepsis and perianal necrosis observed; flaccid scarring (row 6) and cribriform scarring (row 20) observed. Text says 'three patients died of bacterial infections' without naming them, so vital status is 'not reported' for all. Table 1 row 5 (Hinze, 2010) gets 'granulomatous inflammation on biopsy' from the sentence citing [1, 13, 31] for the LAD-1 patient; ref [13] is Hinze 2010 in the paper's reference list and there is only one Hinze row. CONTRADICTION/possible duplicate: the text's 20-year-old male with c.10+4A>G is cited to [17] (Madkaikar 2015), but Table 1's four Madkaikar 2015 rows are aged 4, 11, 2 and 16; the only 20-year-old male in Table 1 is Vahlquist, 2015 (row 14). The text also says 20 LAD patients were found, equal to the Table 1 rows, so this person is probably one of the rows, but which one cannot be determined; he is kept as a separate row 'ref [17] patient' and must not be counted twice without checking. Variant: c.10+4A>G is described as 'in the intron 10 splicesite region' and the next sentence says 'This variation is believed to be a frameshift variation'; because of this contradiction variant_type is 'not reported'. The second compound heterozygous variant is not printed, so it has a row with variant_original_string 'not reported'. 'novel' was not recorded as a pathogenicity classification. No other in-scope persons: Table 2 and all other text patients have other immunodeficiencies (RAG1, NADPH oxidase, CVID, IRF2BP2, NFkB1, BTK, IgA/IgE deficiency). n_patients_reported is null: the paper gives no count of patients with an ITGB2 variant (it gives 20 with LAD); cohort_size_as_stated is the 39 patients with primary immunodeficiency and PG.
